name: NormedSpace.normalize_smul
script:
intro V _ _ r x
have key : ‖r • x‖⁻¹ * r = (SignType.sign r : ℝ) * ‖x‖⁻¹ := by
  rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_inv]
  rcases lt_trichotomy r 0 with h | h | h
  · have hr : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_lt h
    have hc : (SignType.sign r : ℝ) = -1 := by
      rw [sign_neg h]; simp
    have hs : (-r)⁻¹ * r = -1 := by
      rw [inv_neg, neg_mul, inv_mul_cancel₀ hr]
    rw [abs_of_neg h, hc]
    linear_combination ‖x‖⁻¹ * hs
  · subst h
    simp
  · have hr : r ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h
    have hc : (SignType.sign r : ℝ) = 1 := by
      rw [sign_pos h]; simp
    have hs : r⁻¹ * r = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ hr
    rw [abs_of_pos h, hc]
    linear_combination ‖x‖⁻¹ * hs
simp only [NormedSpace.normalize, smul_smul, key]

name: List.insertIdx_injective
script:
intro α n x
induction n with
| zero =>
  intro l₁ l₂ h
  first
    | simpa using h
    | (simp only [List.insertIdx_zero, List.cons.injEq] at h; exact h)
| succ n ih =>
  intro l₁ l₂ h
  cases l₁ with
  | nil =>
    cases l₂ with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons b t =>
      first
        | simp at h
        | simp [List.insertIdx] at h
        | exact absurd h (by simp [List.insertIdx])
  | cons a s =>
    cases l₂ with
    | nil =>
      first
        | simp at h
        | simp [List.insertIdx] at h
        | exact absurd h (by simp [List.insertIdx])
    | cons b t =>
      have h2 : s.insertIdx n x = t.insertIdx n x ∧ a = b := by
        first
          | (simp only [List.insertIdx_succ_cons, List.cons.injEq] at h
             exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
          | (simp only [List.insertIdx, List.cons.injEq] at h
             exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
          | (simp only [List.cons.injEq] at h
             exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
          | (simp at h
             exact ⟨h.2, h.1⟩)
      rw [h2.2, ih h2.1]
